source_title: Fiscal Q4 2022 Earnings Call Prepared Remarks
claim_relevant_visible_text: In addition, inventory adjustments at customers across all end markets are also contributing to demand weakness. These factors are depressing demand for DRAM and NAND to well below end market consumption levels. We are also seeing an extremely aggressive pricing environment. Due to the sharp decline in near-term demand, we expect supply growth to be significantly above demand growth in calendar 2022, contributing to very high supplier inventories for both DRAM and NAND.
researcher_paraphrase: Micron explicitly separated customer inventory correction from end-market consumption: customer adjustments were pushing DRAM/NAND demand below end-market consumption while supply growth above demand contributed to high supplier inventories.
precision_guard: This is Micron's September 2022 management/market statement. It supports an inventory-amplification mechanism but does not quantify customer inventory units, causal weights or prove prior double ordering.
authority_boundary: Micron is primary for its own management statement and supplier inventory condition, but not an independent measurement of all customer inventories or competitors.
